storyCards.headline: I Want Your Love: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
Chic's "I Want Your Love" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Want Your Love" is a song by American band Chic from their second studio album C'est Chic (1978).

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

I Want Your Love was released in 1977.
